Slug variants tried: 'velocity-engineers-private-limited' (520 records, imports only), 'velocity-engineers-pvt-ltd' (page rendered with no rows, gated), 'velocity-engineers' (page rendered with no rows, gated).
domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award, contract or annual-report supply split could be retrieved for the Telangana entity. Searches for the Telangana/Hyderabad-registered company returned no results (search backend returned connection errors), and thecompanycheck.com returned HTTP 403. The only address visible in any trade record is "251, DILSHAD GARDEN G.T.ROAD, SHAHDARA" (Delhi), which does not match the claimed Telangana state — so the Delhi customs entity cannot be attributed to the Telangana company on the available evidence.
note: Identity mismatch is the key finding: the only customs file under this name is a Delhi (Shahdara, G.T. Road) importer of Chinese machinery/spares (HS 84682090, 84669400, 25199090, 90268090), whereas the batch claims a Telangana company with declared HS 847940/847989 (wire/cable-making machinery). No export shipments and no domestic supply evidence were found for either entity — следов поставок не найдено. Declared HS 847940/847989 is not corroborated by any shipment record; the observed codes are import-side only and belong to the Delhi entity, so no HS correction is asserted here. Revenue and export volume: null (not public in accessible sources). No CIN/PAN verified — not public in retrieved sources. Recommend confirming the correct legal entity (Telangana vs Delhi) before any further verification; this is an identity question, not a rejection ground.
